info.title: Wikanvas API
info.description: The public API of Wikanvas, a self-hosted wiki. The web client uses it with its session cookie; external clients and the `wikanvas` CLI use personal access tokens (`Authorization: Bearer qpat_…`). Errors have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"?}, "request_id"}`; clients treat an unknown `code` by its HTTP status. Within v1, changes are additive only.

post.summary: Writes a backup of the database on the server (`<data dir>/backups/wikanvas-<time>.db`).

get.summary: Archived items (archive roots that are not in the trash), most recently archived first, with `archived_at`.

post.summary: Uploads a file (the raw body, sent as `application/octet-stream`).

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item the file is uploaded for (context only, never used for authorization, D36).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Sanitized and cut to 200 characters; default `file`.

requestBody.description: The file's bytes; the type is sniffed

get.summary: The bytes of an attachment.

200.description: The bytes, with the sniffed type

post.summary:
Signs in with email and password and sets the session cookie (`__Host-wikanvas_session; Secure` over HTTPS behind
the proxy, `wikanvas_session` otherwise; `Max-Age` only with `remember`).
Signs out: deletes this session and clears the cookie.

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is cleared

get.summary: The current user, the workspace, and how this request was authenticated (`auth.token` for a token).

patch.summary:
Changes the caller's name, email or theme. Changing the email needs a session (a token gets 403
`session_required`).

post.summary:
Changes the password (session only): `current` must be right (422 `field: "current"` otherwise, never 401), `new`
is 12–1024 bytes. Every other session is revoked; API tokens stay.

204.description: Changed; the other sessions are signed out

get.summary: The caller's live sessions, most recently seen first; `current` marks this request's session.

delete.summary: `?others=true`: signs out every other session (from a token: every session).
Signs out one session of the caller.

get.summary: The live collections in sidebar order.

post.summary: Creates a collection (last, unless `position` says otherwise).

get.summary: A live collection, by id or `url_id`.

404.description: `not_found` (also while it is in the trash)

delete.summary:
Moves a collection to the trash with its live items (it appears in `GET /trash`; items trashed earlier keep their
own entries).

200.description: How many items went to the trash with it

404.description: `not_found` (also when it is already in the trash)

patch.summary: Edits a collection: name, icon (`null` clears it), colour, description, tree order.

404.description: `not_found` (also while it is in the trash)

post.summary: Moves a collection to `position` among the collections.

404.description: `not_found` (also while it is in the trash)

post.summary: Restores a collection from the trash, with exactly the items its deletion trashed.

get.summary:
A collection's visible, unarchived items as one flat list, parents before children, siblings in the
collection's `child_order`. 304 while `If-None-Match` holds the current ETag.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: A previous ETag: 304 while the tree is unchanged

404.description: `not_found` (also while the collection is in the trash)

get.summary: A collection's items at every depth, most recently updated first.

404.description: `not_found` (also while the collection is in the trash)

get.summary: What a client needs before signing in: versions, setup state, the Inkboard build and the limits.
Unpublished items (in M1 only those unpublished through the API or CLI, D23), most recently updated first.

Downloads the whole workspace: a tar of `manifest.json`, `wikanvas.db` (without sessions, API tokens or password
hashes) and `files/**`.

post.summary: Creates a document or board, published (D23), with its content initialized, at `position` (omitted: last).

409.description: `parent_invalid` (collection or parent missing, trashed, archived or foreign), `setup_required`

get.summary:
An item in any state, with its collection, breadcrumbs, star, effective publication, trash and archive dates and
board meta. `ETag: "m{meta_version}"` is for a later `If-Match`; this route never answers 304.

delete.summary:
Moves an item and its subtree to the trash; with `?discard_empty=true`, deletes a new empty item permanently
instead (created under 24 h ago, no children, blank title, empty body; published or not), else 409 `not_empty`.

200.description: How many items were trashed (or deleted)

patch.summary:
Renames an item or sets `full_width`. With `If-Match: "m{n}"`, a stale tag is 412 `rev_mismatch`; without it the
last write wins.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: `"m{meta_version}"` from GET; `*` or none: last write wins

post.summary: Archives an item with its subtree (the descendants that are neither archived nor trashed).

get.summary:
The board's native Inkboard envelope `{"format":"inkboard","version":2,"document":…}` (D8, D51): its images
inline as base64 and `document.name` set to the item's title (D31). Unknown fields a newer engine wrote are kept.
Never answers 304: the body holds the live title, which the ETag does not version (D45).

404.description: `not_found`: no such item, or it is not a board

429.description: `rate_limited` (`reason: "busy"`, `Retry-After`): too many large board bodies are being sent

put.summary: Replaces the board with a native envelope (§6.2, D51).
put.description:
The body is validated with Inkboard's own reader; its inline images move to the blob store, everything else is
stored as sent, so fields this server does not know survive. `document.name` is ignored: the title is the item's.
A body equal to the stored one changes nothing and answers the current revision. A token's write first keeps a
`pre-api` revision of the current state, unless the last write came from the same token (D53).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: `"r{rev}"` of the revision the body is based on (a `W/` prefix is ignored), or `*` to overwrite whatever is current

parameters.name: X-Wikanvas-Engine
parameters.description: The writing engine's version (the web client sends its `engineVersion`); stored as `api` when absent. At most 128 printable ASCII characters

requestBody.description: The native Inkboard envelope `{"format": "inkboard", "version": 2, "document": {…}}`, up to `limits.max_board_mb` (`GET /config`)

408.description: `request_timeout`: the body did not arrive within 120 s

412.description: `rev_mismatch`: the board changed; `details {rev, etag}` name the current revision

422.description: `invalid_board` (also JSON nested deeper than `limits.json_depth`), `board_too_new`, `validation` (`field`: `kind` for a document, `X-Wikanvas-Engine`, `body`)

get.summary: The board as a `.inkboard` file: the bytes of `GET …/board`, as an attachment named after the title.

200.description: The envelope, with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<title>.inkboard"; filename*=UTF-8''<title>.inkboard`

404.description: `not_found`: no such item, or it is not a board

429.description: `rate_limited` (`reason: "busy"`, `Retry-After`): too many large board bodies are being sent

get.summary:
One page of the board as SVG (`svg::export_approx`, D10), for thumbnails, the loading placeholder and the
read-only view.
get.description:
Without `rev`: the current page, `Cache-Control: no-cache` with `ETag: "r{rev}"`. With the current `rev`:
`Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000, immutable`. With another `rev`: 307 to the current one. An empty page
answers 204. Images that would make the SVG too large are drawn as grey boxes, and a page (or a page after the
board's preview budget) that is too large to preview is a small card that says so. Over 1 KiB it is sent
gzip-encoded when the client accepts it.

parameters.name: rev
parameters.description: The board revision the page is wanted at (`BoardMeta.rev`).

200.description: The page's SVG (`nosniff`, a sandboxing CSP)

Cache-Control.description: `no-cache` without `rev`, immutable with the current one

307.description: `rev` is not the current revision: the URL of the current one

404.description: `not_found`: no such item, not a board, or no such page

429.description: `rate_limited` (`reason: "busy"`, `Retry-After`): too many large board bodies are being sent

get.summary: An item's visible children in its collection's `child_order` (an archived item's archived children).
The document's Yjs state: the whole update, or with `since` only what that state vector lacks.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Base64 Yjs state vector: return only what the client is missing.

200.description: The Yjs state (base64 v1 update and state vector)

get.summary:
The document as Wikanvas Markdown 1 (§6.4). Never 304: it prints live titles. The lossy steps are listed in
`Wikanvas-Conversion-Warnings`.

put.summary:
Writes the document from Markdown (§6.4): a diff against the `If-Match` base, stored as one Yjs update. A stale
`If-Match` is 412 (`details.mergeable`), unless the document already equals the target (200 `changed: false`)
or `?merge=true` merges it with the newer updates. Only `text/markdown` is accepted.

parameters.name: merge
parameters.description: Merge with newer updates when `If-Match` is stale but still reconstructible (D50).

200.description: Written (or already equal), with the new `ETag`

get.summary:
The document as normalized ProseMirror JSON (`editor.getJSON()`, §6.4), `ETag: "d{seq}"`; 304 for a matching
`If-None-Match`.

put.summary:
Writes the document from ProseMirror JSON (§6.4): validated against schema v1 (422 `invalid_document` with a
JSON pointer), then diffed against the `If-Match` base by `blockId` and content, and stored as one Yjs update.

200.description: Written (or already equal), with the new `ETag`

post.summary:
Saves one Yjs update (§6.1): 409 `missing_deps` with the server's state vector when it depends on structs the
server lacks; a re-sent update is a no-op. A token's first write after someone else's stores a `pre-api`
revision (D53).

requestBody.description: A base64 Yjs v1 update (up to 16 MiB), and the editor's JSON

post.summary:
Duplicates an item right after it: its content (Y state or board bytes, attachments, text) and `full_width`;
the title gets " (copy)". Children are not copied; the copy is published.

Moves an item with its subtree: to another parent (`null`: the top level), optionally in another collection, at
`position` among the new siblings (omitted: last).

Publishes an item; with `with_ancestors: true`, its draft ancestors too. Not called by the M1 web client (D23).
The body may be omitted (`with_ancestors: false`).

requestBody.description: Optional; `{}` or none publishes the item alone

post.summary:
Restores the item's trash unit (its trash root). The root goes to the end of the top level when its parent is
gone (`moved_to_top`). Returns the root.

409.description: `parent_invalid` (the collection is in the trash: restore it first), `conflict` (not in the trash), `setup_required`

put.summary:
Stars an item at `position` among the caller's stars (omitted: last; an existing star keeps its place). The body
may be omitted.

delete.summary: Removes the caller's star (also when there is none).

get.summary: The derived plain text that search indexes (§6.1, §6.2), in any state.

post.summary:
Unarchives the item's archive unit (its archive root). The root goes to the end of the top level when its parent
is gone (`moved_to_top`). Returns the root.

Makes an item a draft. Always allowed (whatever its parent and children); in M1 the only way an item becomes a
draft (D23).

Records that the caller viewed the item (`GET /recent`). The web client calls it when it opens an item; the CLI
never does.

get.summary: The OpenAPI 3.1 document of this API.
The items the caller viewed (`POST /items/{id}/view`), most recently viewed first, with `last_viewed_at`.

Document schema v1 as data: every node and mark with its attrs, types, defaults and content rules (§6.4); the
nodes and marks a ProseMirror PUT may use.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: At most 500 characters. `"…"` keeps a phrase, `-word` excludes; a query with no positive term finds nothing.

200.description: One page of hits; snippets mark hits as parts with `hit: true`

get.summary:
Items whose title matches `q` (the last word a prefix, accents folded), best first; a blank `q` lists the most
recently updated items. Visible and unarchived only.

200.description: At most `limit` items with their paths

get.summary: Whether first-run setup is still needed.

post.summary:
First-run setup: creates the owner and the workspace with the setup code from the server log, seeds "Getting
started", and signs the owner in.

get.summary: The sidebar: the live collections, the caller's stars (visible, unarchived, in star order) and the drafts count.
The caller's starred items (visible, unarchived) in star order, with `starred_at`.
The caller's live tokens and expired ones (not revoked), newest first, at most 100. Never the secret or its hash.

post.summary: Creates a token; the response is the only place its secret ever appears.
post.description:
Scopes cannot exceed the caller's; a calling token cannot grant `admin` (403 `session_required`) and the new
token cannot outlive it (422, `field: "expires_in_days"`). A session sends `password` for an `admin` or
never-expiring token (422, `field: "password"`, when missing or wrong). At most 100 live tokens per user.

delete.summary: Revokes the calling token itself (`wikanvas auth logout --revoke`), and the tokens it created.
Revokes a token of the caller, and the tokens it created. Takes effect on the next request.

404.description: `not_found`: no live token of the caller has this id

get.summary:
The trash, roots only: deleted collections and item roots, each with its purge date (30 days after deletion);
an item root also with the number of descendants trashed with it and its path.

delete.summary: Empties the trash: every item root and every deleted collection.
Permanently deletes a collection in the trash with every item in it.
Permanently deletes an item in the trash with its whole subtree.

get.summary: Items at every depth of every collection, most recently updated first.
The workspace's name and logo.

patch.summary: Renames the workspace or sets its logo (`logo_attachment_id: null` removes it).

ApiToken.description: A personal access token as lists show it. Never the secret or its hash.

parent_token_id.description: The token that created this one; it is revoked with it (D42).

prefix.description: The first 12 characters of the token (`qpat_` + 7), for recognizing it.

width.description: Images only, read from the header.

AttrSpec.description: An attribute of a node or mark.

default.description: The default value (`null` when the attr has none).

type.description:
The JSON type in TypeScript notation, e.g. `integer`, `boolean`, `string | null`, `integer[] | null`,
`"info" | "tip"`.

AuthMethodKind.description: How the current request was authenticated.

BackupResult.description: Response of `POST /admin/backup`: a file on the server.

BoardMeta.description: What the server knows about a board without loading it: `board_state.meta` plus the revision and preview state.

bytes.description: Size of the full envelope in bytes.

objects.description: Number of objects on all pages.

preview_rev.description: The revision the stored SVG previews were made from, `null` before the first preview.

rev.description: The board revision; its ETag is `"r{rev}"`.

text_excerpt.description: The first 4 KB of the board's search text (page names, labels, table cells, LaTeX), one entry per line.

svg_len.description:
Size of the page's SVG preview in bytes; `null` while there is none, and for a page after the board's preview
budget (its preview is a "too large to preview" card). List views show a placeholder when it is over 2 MB.

ChildOrder.description: How a collection orders its items in the tree. Non-manual orders are computed at read time.

icon.description: A lucide icon name; `null` shows a letter tile.

item_count.description: Live items in the collection, at every depth.

CollectionDeleted.description: Response of `DELETE /collections/{id}` (a soft delete; the collection appears in Trash).

CollectionPatch.description: Body of `PATCH /collections/{id}`. Omitted fields stay unchanged; `icon: null` clears the icon.

CollectionTree.description:
Response of `GET /collections/{id}/tree`: every visible, unarchived item, flat, in `child_order`. ETag
`"t{tree_version}.{viewer_epoch}"`.

commit.description: The git commit the server was built from.

oneOf.description: `null` when no Inkboard build is embedded.

multi_user.description: Whether more than one account can sign in (more than one user that is not disabled, D148).

ConversionWarning.description: One kind of lossy step, with where it first happened and how often.

path.description: A JSON pointer, or `line:column` for Markdown input.

ConversionWarningCode.description: A lossy step of a conversion (§6.4 table). New codes may be added within v1.

CreatedToken.description: Response of `POST /tokens`: the only response that ever contains the secret.

Crumb.description: One step of a breadcrumb path, root first.

doc.description: Normalized ProseMirror JSON `{type: "doc", content}` (the shape of `editor.getJSON()`, §6.4).
ProseMirror JSON `{type: "doc", content}`; missing attrs get their defaults.

DocSchema.description:
Response of `GET /schema/doc`: schema v1 as data (`wikanvas-core::schema`, §6.4), byte for byte
`fixtures/schema/v1.json`, which the web fixture writer dumps from the live TipTap schema.

nodes.description: In schema order (ProseMirror's own `doc` and `text` included).

seq.description: The newest stored update (the document ETag is `"d{seq}"`).

state_vector.description: Base64 Yjs state vector of the server's document.

pm_json.description: The editor's ProseMirror JSON after the update (a cache; rebuildable).

state_vector.description: Base64 Yjs state vector after the update.

DocWriteResult.description: Response of the Markdown and ProseMirror PUTs, with the new `ETag`.

changed.description: `false` when the document already equalled the target (nothing was written).

merged.description: `true` when the write was merged with newer updates (`?merge=true` or `If-Match: *`).

request_id.description: The `X-Request-Id` of the response. Always set by the server; `null` only in errors the CLI raises itself.

format_version.description: The envelope version the engine writes (2).

breadcrumbs.description: Ancestors, root first (the item itself excluded).

effectively_published.description: The item and every ancestor are published (D23).

full_width.description: The "Full width" setting (`PATCH /items/{id} {full_width}`); the web client applies it to documents.

oneOf.description: When a trashed item is purged.

ItemKind.description: The kind of an item (lookup table `item_kinds`).

ItemSummary.description: An item as the tree and every list show it.

oneOf.description: The last body save; `null` when never edited.

parent_id.description: `null` at the top level of the collection.

published.description: `published_at` is set. Items are published on create; only `unpublish` makes a draft (D23).

ItemText.description: Response of `GET /items/{id}/text`: the derived plain text that search indexes.

ItemTrashed.description: Response of `DELETE /items/{id}`: the number of items trashed (or deleted, with `discard_empty`).

ItemsArchived.description: Response of `POST /items/{id}/archive`: the number of items archived (the subtree).

Limits.description: `Config.limits`: every request limit of §7.1 and D33.

ListedItem.description:
An entry of a paginated item list (`/archive`, `/drafts`, `/starred`, `/recent`, `/updated`,
`/collections/{id}/updated`): the item, its path, and the list's own field.

remember.description: "Keep me signed in": a persistent cookie with a 30-day window.

MarkSpec.description: A mark type of the document schema.

excludes.description: The ProseMirror `excludes` expression: null excludes only the mark itself, `_` every mark.

inclusive.description: Whether the mark extends to text typed at its end (null: ProseMirror's default, true).

rank.description: Position in the schema's mark order (marks are sorted by it).

MePatch.description: Body of `PATCH /auth/me`. Changing `email` needs a session (a token gets 403 `session_required`).

parent_id.description:
The new parent; `null` for the top level. Required (§7.2): a body without it is 422 `validation`, so a
reorder that leaves it out never moves the item to the top level by accident.

NewItem.description: Body of `POST /items`. The item is published on create (D23).

expires_in_days.description:
1–3650. Omitted: 90 days; `null`: never (a session must then send `password`; a calling token's expiry caps
it).

password.description: The session's password, required for an `admin` or never-expiring token.

scopes.description: At most the caller's scopes; a calling token can never grant `admin`.

NodeSpec.description: A node type of the document schema.

content.description: The ProseMirror content expression, e.g. `inline*`; null for a leaf.

marks.description:
The marks allowed in this node's content: null for ProseMirror's default (every mark in inline content),
`""` for none, `"_"` for all, otherwise mark names.

Page_ListedItem.description:
One page of a paginated list. `next_cursor` is `null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque, stable under
concurrent inserts and deletes, and valid only with the query parameters that produced them.

items.description:
An entry of a paginated item list (`/archive`, `/drafts`, `/starred`, `/recent`, `/updated`,
`/collections/{id}/updated`): the item, its path, and the list's own field.

Page_SearchHit.description:
One page of a paginated list. `next_cursor` is `null` on the last page. Cursors are opaque, stable under
concurrent inserts and deletes, and valid only with the query parameters that produced them.

snippet.description: The snippet in parts; `hit` parts are the matched terms. Render as text nodes, never as HTML.

PasswordChange.description: Body of `POST /auth/password` (session only; revokes the other sessions).

Position.description:
A position among siblings (or collections, or stars). The server computes the sort key (D6). With both ids
omitted (or `null`) the row goes last.

after_id.description: Place the row right after this sibling.

before_id.description: Place the row right before this sibling.

RestoredItem.description:
Response of restore and unarchive: the item, and whether its subtree went to the top of the collection because
the old parent is gone.

Role.description: A user's role (lookup table `user_roles`): one owner; admins, members and viewers join through invites (D148).

Scope.description:
A token scope. The hierarchy is `read` ⊂ `write` ⊂ `admin` (the variant order); a session has every scope.
`read`: every GET except token and session management and export; `write`: content and structure; `admin`:
purge, workspace and account settings, sessions, tokens, export and backup (§7.3).

snippet.description: The snippet in parts; `hit` parts are the matched terms. Render as text nodes, never as HTML.

SetupRequest.description: Body of `POST /setup` (rate-limited per IP; 409 `already_setup` once an owner exists).

code.description: The setup code from the server log (`XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`) or `WIKANVAS_SETUP_TOKEN`.

drafts_count.description: Unpublished items (in M1 only those unpublished through the API or CLI, D23).

SnippetPart.description: A part of a search snippet.

Timestamp.description:
A point in time. Unix milliseconds in Rust and SQL (D5); on the wire an RFC 3339 UTC string with millisecond
precision, e.g. `2026-10-28T09:30:00.000Z`. Parsing accepts any RFC 3339 offset and fraction (truncated to
milliseconds).

path.description: Ancestors at the time of listing, root first.

TrashedItem.description: A trash root item (its trashed descendants are counted, not listed).

User.description: A user, as every response shows it.

UserEnvelope.description: `{user}`: the response of setup, login and `PATCH /auth/me`.

WasmBytes.description: Sizes of the engine's wasm file and its precompressed variants.

WorkspacePatch.description: Body of `PATCH /workspace`. `logo_attachment_id: null` removes the logo.

bearer.description: A personal access token, `qpat_` + 46 base62 characters, with the scopes read ⊂ write ⊂ admin.

session.name: wikanvas_session
session.description: The web client's session cookie. Over HTTPS (behind the proxy) it is named `__Host-wikanvas_session`. A session has every scope; cookie-authenticated mutations must pass the Fetch-Metadata / Origin check.
